retention: Keep the active item and at most two recently passing items; durable outcomes belong in specifications, ADRs, commits, and reviews.

items.title: Create the Rust workspace foundation and delivery checks
acceptance: The proposed Cargo workspace and crate dependency direction are represented.
An empty CLI builds and its help output is testable.
Formatting, Clippy, tests, dependency policy, and secret scanning have executable checks.
SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md encode the approved security and fixture boundaries.

verification.outcome: not run due account usage limit; explicitly deferred and non-blocking by user direction

items.title: Implement the versioned non-secret profile registry
acceptance: Profile IDs, validated names, providers, storage locators, and statuses are strongly typed.
Registry schema v1 round-trips without storing credential material or full account emails.
Writes use a same-directory temporary file, flush, atomic replacement, and a mutation lock.
Duplicate case-folded names, unsupported schema versions, corrupt JSON, and unsafe file types fail closed.
Migration scaffolding and synthetic unit, integration, and property-style invariant tests pass.
